description: Cryptocurrency exchange platform providing spot, futures, and margin trading alongside wallet and web3 services via APIs.
auth_notes: API requests require an API key and an HMAC signature (or Ed25519/RSA keys) computed over the query parameters and payload using the secret key.
credential_notes: Any registered user can generate API keys for free directly via their account settings interface.
api_notes: Comprehensive coverage of spot trading, futures, margin, wallet operations, market data streams, and user data updates.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by Binance; only community-driven implementations exist.
rationale: Binance offers extensive, fully documented public REST and WebSocket APIs with free self-serve credential generation.

evidence.note: Details signing and API key requirements for authenticated endpoints.
Outlines API key setup instructions under the Quick Start section.
